paragraphs.source_en: As planned, Ishida Mitsunari led 6,700 men out of Sawayama Castle and into Ōgaki Castle on the tenth day of the eighth month in the fifth year of Keichō. He had already agreed with Shimazu Yoshihiro, Shimazu Toyohisa, and Konishi Yukinaga that they would entice their commander-in-chief, Mōri Terumoto, out of Osaka Castle and bring him to Gifu. He had staked everything on this war, and the moment when the results would be tested was now close at hand.

units.source_en: As planned, Ishida Mitsunari led 6,700 men out of Sawayama Castle and into Ōgaki Castle on the tenth day of the eighth month in the fifth year of Keichō.

paragraphs.source_en: The eastern lords were impatient to march west the instant Ieyasu gave the order precisely because they had seen through Mitsunari's unease. In other words, Tokugawa power held the realm in awe.

paragraphs.source_en: Ever since entering Ōgaki Castle, Mitsunari had grown increasingly uneasy. If Terumoto did not come forward, Ieyasu would realize what was happening and surely order his great army to march from Edo.

paragraphs.source_en: Only after Mitsunari himself reached the battlefield did he grasp the terror of war. As the late Taikō's inspector and strategist, he had once delivered harsh orders to the troops campaigning in Korea. It was precisely their bitter resentment of his borrowed authority that had now brought the generals together at Kiyosu Castle to bar his way. But he was no longer Toyotomi Hideyoshi's inspector, nor was he the true commander; he could act only from behind the scenes.

paragraphs.source_en: Mitsunari gradually came to see that Ieyasu was a colossal rock that simply could not be moved. Advancing and retreating on a battlefield, he learned, was an entirely different matter from dealing with people in ordinary life.

units.source_en: Inside Gifu Castle, the men were also urgently debating what course to take.
units.source_zh: 岐阜城内，众人亦正紧急商议对策。

units.source_en: The retainer Kizukuri Tomomasa advocated defending the castle: “The enemy is numerous. We can only hold the castle to the death and await Lord Jibu-shōyū's arrival with reinforcements.”
units.source_zh: 家臣木造具正主张守城：“敌人兵多，我们只能据城死守，以待治部少辅率部前来援救。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 岐阜城内，众人亦正紧急商议对策。家臣木造具正主张守城：“敌人兵多，我们只能据城死守，以待治部少辅率部前来援救。”

paragraphs.source_en: Night fell, and Gifu lay shrouded in black clouds; when dawn came, it would be the twenty-second day of the eighth month. An autumn wind blew in gusts, and not a wisp of mist hung over either the upstream crossing of the Kiso River or the area around Kōda, making it easy for both armies to deploy their formations. As the first pale light appeared, the brilliant banners of the two armies facing each other across the river shone with startling vividness.

units.source_en: Night fell, and Gifu lay shrouded in black clouds; when dawn came, it would be the twenty-second day of the eighth month.
units.source_zh: 夜幕降临，岐阜为黑云笼罩，天亮之后便是八月二十二了。

units.source_en: An autumn wind blew in gusts, and not a wisp of mist hung over either the upstream crossing of the Kiso River or the area around Kōda, making it easy for both armies to deploy their formations.
units.source_zh: 秋风阵阵，木曾川上游的渡河口和河田附近均无一丝雾气，正方便两军排兵布阵。

units.source_en: As the first pale light appeared, the brilliant banners of the two armies facing each other across the river shone with startling vividness.
units.source_zh: 天刚蒙蒙亮，隔河相望的两军，艳丽的旗幡格外耀眼。

paragraphs.source_zh: 夜幕降临，岐阜为黑云笼罩，天亮之后便是八月二十二了。秋风阵阵，木曾川上游的渡河口和河田附近均无一丝雾气，正方便两军排兵布阵。天刚蒙蒙亮，隔河相望的两军，艳丽的旗幡格外耀眼。

paragraphs.source_en: The first shots were fired by Oda's contingent of the Western Army. The attackers and defenders had utterly different thoughts in mind. At that moment, Ikeda's troops in the Eastern Army's vanguard had no intention of opening battle at all. Terumasa was still waiting for Fukushima's signal after his downstream crossing at Ogoshi. According to plan, once Fukushima and his men lit the signal fire, the two columns would attack together.

units.source_en: The first shots were fired by Oda's contingent of the Western Army.
units.source_zh: 最先放枪的乃西军织田部。

units.source_en: The attackers and defenders had utterly different thoughts in mind.
units.source_zh: 攻方与守方的心思差别巨大。

units.source_en: At that moment, Ikeda's troops in the Eastern Army's vanguard had no intention of opening battle at all.

ja.t: くつもりなどまったくなかった。

units.source_zh: 此时，东军先锋池田部根本还无开战的想法。

units.source_en: Terumasa was still waiting for Fukushima's signal after his downstream crossing at Ogoshi.
units.source_zh: 他还在等待从下游尾越渡河的福岛的信号。

units.source_en: According to plan, once Fukushima and his men lit the signal fire, the two columns would attack together.
units.source_zh: 照计，福岛等人点燃烽火后，两路人马一齐发起攻击。

paragraphs.source_zh: 最先放枪的乃西军织田部。攻方与守方的心思差别巨大。此时，东军先锋池田部根本还无开战的想法。他还在等待从下游尾越渡河的福岛的信号。照计，福岛等人点燃烽火后，两路人马一齐发起攻击。

paragraphs.source_en: But Oda's men had not only been firing since dawn; it also appeared that, unless challenged, they meant to wade across the river and attack.

units.source_en: But Oda's men had not only been firing since dawn; it also appeared that, unless challenged, they meant to wade across the river and attack.

ja.t: めただけでなく、こちらが

units.source_zh: 可织田人马不但从拂晓时分就开始放枪，而且，看样子若不应战，他们还似要涉河攻过来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 可织田人马不但从拂晓时分就开始放枪，而且，看样子若不应战，他们还似要涉河攻过来。

paragraphs.source_en: Once the enemy attacked first, however, events became impossible to control.

units.source_en: Once the enemy attacked first, however, events became impossible to control.
units.source_zh: 但一旦敌方率先发起攻击，一切便难以控制。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但一旦敌方率先发起攻击，一切便难以控制。

paragraphs.source_en: The Eastern Army was in no danger; the Western Army's bullets merely cracked uselessly through the sky across the river. Yet among the Eastern soldiers crouching along the bank and glaring fixedly at the enemy, anger burned ever fiercer.

units.source_en: The Eastern Army was in no danger; the Western Army's bullets merely cracked uselessly through the sky across the river. Yet among the Eastern soldiers crouching along the bank and glaring fixedly at the enemy, anger burned ever fiercer.
units.source_zh: 东军处境并不危险，西军的枪弹隔着河在天空中徒然暴响，但潜伏在河岸、死死盯着敌人的东军将士，怒火却越烧越旺。

paragraphs.source_zh: 东军处境并不危险，西军的枪弹隔着河在天空中徒然暴响，但潜伏在河岸、死死盯着敌人的东军将士，怒火却越烧越旺。

paragraphs.source_en: At Terumasa's command, the Eastern Army answered the attack, every man charging like a tiger descending from the mountains. Igi Tadamasa's troops immediately raced upstream, while Hitotsuyanagi Naomori also began crossing, making straight for Kōmyōji on the opposite bank. When Horio Tadauji followed them across, the sporadic gunfire from the far bank turned into desperate resistance.

units.source_en: At Terumasa's command, the Eastern Army answered the attack, every man charging like a tiger descending from the mountains.
units.source_zh: 在辉政的命令下，东军应战，一个个如猛虎下山。

units.source_en: Igi Tadamasa's troops immediately raced upstream, while Hitotsuyanagi Naomori also began crossing, making straight for Kōmyōji on the opposite bank.
units.source_zh: 伊木忠正所部立刻直奔河川上游，一柳直盛也开始渡河，目标直指河对岸的光明寺。

units.source_en: When Horio Tadauji followed them across, the sporadic gunfire from the far bank turned into desperate resistance.
units.source_zh: 当堀尾忠氏亦随之渡河时，对岸零星的射击变成了拼命抵抗。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在辉政的命令下，东军应战，一个个如猛虎下山。伊木忠正所部立刻直奔河川上游，一柳直盛也开始渡河，目标直指河对岸的光明寺。当堀尾忠氏亦随之渡河时，对岸零星的射击变成了拼命抵抗。

paragraphs.source_en: At first, to avoid being shot, the soldiers were forbidden to straighten their bodies, and the warriors advanced pressed close against one side of their horses. Before they knew it, however, all the river-crossing troops were marching with heads high and chests out, transformed into roaring lions.

units.source_en: At first, to avoid being shot, the soldiers were forbidden to straighten their bodies, and the warriors advanced pressed close against one side of their horses. Before they knew it, however, all the river-crossing troops were marching with heads high and chests out, transformed into roaring lions.
units.source_zh: 开始时，为了避免中弹，禁止士兵直起身子，将士把身体紧贴在马身一侧前进，不知不觉间，渡河部队全都昂首挺胸，成了怒号的雄狮。

paragraphs.source_zh: 开始时，为了避免中弹，禁止士兵直起身子，将士把身体紧贴在马身一侧前进，不知不觉间，渡河部队全都昂首挺胸，成了怒号的雄狮。

paragraphs.source_en: Ikeda Terumasa brandished his command standard and plunged into the torrent; Asano Yoshinaga, eyes bloodshot, also leapt into the water. Near the riverbank, the crack of gunfire mingled with the roars of men and horses, and more and more of the wounded fell. Ōtsuka Gondayū, an old retainer of Hitotsuyanagi Naomori, fell at the water's edge; on Oda's side, Takeichi Zenbei and Iinuma Kokanpei likewise fell one after another while trying to stop the Eastern Army's crossing.

units.source_en: Ikeda Terumasa brandished his command standard and plunged into the torrent; Asano Yoshinaga, eyes bloodshot, also leapt into the water.
units.source_zh: 池田辉政挥舞着令旗跃进激流，浅野幸长也血红着眼睛跳进水中。

units.source_en: Near the riverbank, the crack of gunfire mingled with the roars of men and horses, and more and more of the wounded fell.
units.source_zh: 河岸附近，枪弹声与人马的怒号交织在一起，负伤倒下的人愈来愈多。

units.source_en: Ōtsuka Gondayū, an old retainer of Hitotsuyanagi Naomori, fell at the water's edge; on Oda's side, Takeichi Zenbei and Iinuma Kokanpei likewise fell one after another while trying to stop the Eastern Army's crossing.
units.source_zh: 一柳直盛的老臣大冢权太夫倒在了水边，为阻击东军渡河，织田一方的武市善兵卫、饭沼小勘平也纷纷倒下。

paragraphs.source_zh: 池田辉政挥舞着令旗跃进激流，浅野幸长也血红着眼睛跳进水中。河岸附近，枪弹声与人马的怒号交织在一起，负伤倒下的人愈来愈多。一柳直盛的老臣大冢权太夫倒在了水边，为阻击东军渡河，织田一方的武市善兵卫、饭沼小勘平也纷纷倒下。

paragraphs.source_en: The men had long since cast their agreement with Fukushima Masanori from their minds. The men under Arima, Yamauchi, Matsushita, Togawa, and the others competed to cross the river and launched a fierce attack on the Oda contingent's flank.

units.source_en: The men had long since cast their agreement with Fukushima Masanori from their minds.
units.source_zh: 人们早把与福岛正则的约定抛到脑后。

units.source_en: The men under Arima, Yamauchi, Matsushita, Togawa, and the others competed to cross the river and launched a fierce attack on the Oda contingent's flank.
units.source_zh: 有马、山内、松下、户川等人的属下竞相渡河，向织田部侧翼发起猛攻。

paragraphs.source_zh: 人们早把与福岛正则的约定抛到脑后。有马、山内、松下、户川等人的属下竞相渡河，向织田部侧翼发起猛攻。

paragraphs.source_en: Peace can be built only through unceasing effort, yet once war begins, a battlefield turns into hell on earth in the blink of an eye.

units.source_en: Peace can be built only through unceasing effort, yet once war begins, a battlefield turns into hell on earth in the blink of an eye.
units.source_zh: 构筑太平需要不断付出努力，而一旦发起战争，战场就在转瞬间变成了人间地狱。

paragraphs.source_zh: 构筑太平需要不断付出努力，而一旦发起战争，战场就在转瞬间变成了人间地狱。

paragraphs.source_en: Near noon, the western defensive line was breached, and Oda's forces began to retreat.

units.source_en: Near noon, the western defensive line was breached, and Oda's forces began to retreat.
units.source_zh: 近午时分，西侧防线被攻陷，织田的人马开始撤退。

paragraphs.source_zh: 近午时分，西侧防线被攻陷，织田的人马开始撤退。

paragraphs.source_en: Meanwhile, Fukushima Masanori and the units that had crossed downstream took Takehana Castle, defended for the Western Army by Sugiura Gozaemon and Mōri Kamon, on the evening of the twenty-second. They then advanced to the vicinity of Tarō Embankment and prepared to camp for the night. They did not yet know that Ikeda's troops and the other upstream units had already crossed the river and broken through the defensive line.

units.source_en: Meanwhile, Fukushima Masanori and the units that had crossed downstream took Takehana Castle, defended for the Western Army by Sugiura Gozaemon and Mōri Kamon, on the evening of the twenty-second. They then advanced to the vicinity of Tarō Embankment and prepared to camp for the night.
units.source_zh: 从下游渡河的福岛正则等部，则于二十二日傍晚拿下了西军杉浦五左卫门与毛利扫部把守的竹鼻城，然后进至太郎堤一带，准备夜营。

units.source_en: They did not yet know that Ikeda's troops and the other upstream units had already crossed the river and broken through the defensive line.
units.source_zh: 他们还不知上游的池田等部业已渡河，并突破了防线。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从下游渡河的福岛正则等部，则于二十二日傍晚拿下了西军杉浦五左卫门与毛利扫部把守的竹鼻城，然后进至太郎堤一带，准备夜营。他们还不知上游的池田等部业已渡河，并突破了防线。

paragraphs.source_en: During the attack on Takehana Castle, Masanori first persuaded his old acquaintances Mōri Kamon and Kajikawa Sanjūrō to surrender, leaving only Sugiura Gozaemon to resist stubbornly. Masanori fought a fierce battle against him from the Hour of the Serpent to the Hour of the Monkey, finally annihilating his force, and then marched his men triumphantly to Tarō Embankment.

units.source_en: During the attack on Takehana Castle, Masanori first persuaded his old acquaintances Mōri Kamon and Kajikawa Sanjūrō to surrender, leaving only Sugiura Gozaemon to resist stubbornly.
units.source_zh: 攻打竹鼻城时，正则先是劝降了故知毛利扫部和梶川三十郎，只剩下杉浦五左卫门在顽固抵抗。

units.source_en: Masanori fought a fierce battle against him from the Hour of the Serpent to the Hour of the Monkey, finally annihilating his force, and then marched his men triumphantly to Tarō Embankment.
units.source_zh: 正则与其展开一场激战，从巳时到申时，最后将其全歼，然后意气扬扬把人马开到太郎堤。

paragraphs.source_zh: 攻打竹鼻城时，正则先是劝降了故知毛利扫部和梶川三十郎，只剩下杉浦五左卫门在顽固抵抗。正则与其展开一场激战，从巳时到申时，最后将其全歼，然后意气扬扬把人马开到太郎堤。

paragraphs.source_en: A beacon should have been lit, but Masanori instead ordered houses set ablaze, and homes whose occupants knew nothing of the war fell victim to the flames. As the ominous blaze lit the evening sky, a soldier came rushing through the thick smoke to report to Masanori: “A messenger has arrived from Lord Ikeda Sanzaemon Terumasa.”

units.source_en: A beacon should have been lit, but Masanori instead ordered houses set ablaze, and homes whose occupants knew nothing of the war fell victim to the flames.
units.source_zh: 本当点燃狼烟，正则却命人纵火，对战事一无所知的民家遂遭了殃。

units.source_en: As the ominous blaze lit the evening sky, a soldier came rushing through the thick smoke to report to Masanori: “A messenger has arrived from Lord Ikeda Sanzaemon Terumasa.”
units.source_zh: 不祥的烈焰照亮傍晚的天空时，一名士卒风风火火穿过浓烟，来向正则报信：“池田三左卫门辉政大人派来使者。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 本当点燃狼烟，正则却命人纵火，对战事一无所知的民家遂遭了殃。不祥的烈焰照亮傍晚的天空时，一名士卒风风火火穿过浓烟，来向正则报信：“池田三左卫门辉政大人派来使者。”

paragraphs.source_en: Masanori was puzzled. “What business can he have? Bring him in at once.” If anything had happened to Terumasa along the way and his crossing had failed, Masanori would have to detach troops to rescue him. Muttering to himself, Masanori rose from his camp stool.

units.source_en: Masanori was puzzled. “What business can he have?

ja.t: はいぶかしんだ。「いったい

units.source_zh: 正则有些纳闷：“究竟有何事？

units.source_en: Bring him in at once.”
units.source_zh: 快让他进来。”

units.source_en: If anything had happened to Terumasa along the way and his crossing had failed, Masanori would have to detach troops to rescue him.
units.source_zh: 万一辉政在途中有什么差池，渡河失利，自己就必须分出兵力前去救援。

units.source_en: Muttering to himself, Masanori rose from his camp stool.
units.source_zh: 正则咕哝着，从床几上站起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正则有些纳闷：“究竟有何事？快让他进来。”万一辉政在途中有什么差池，渡河失利，自己就必须分出兵力前去救援。正则咕哝着，从床几上站起来。

paragraphs.source_en: The messenger reported that the upstream forces had crossed the Kiso River that morning, fought a fierce battle with the enemy at Komeno, and were now approaching Gifu.

units.source_en: The messenger reported that the upstream forces had crossed the Kiso River that morning, fought a fierce battle with the enemy at Komeno, and were now approaching Gifu.
units.source_zh: 使者禀报，上游部队已于今晨渡过木曾川，与敌军在米野展开激战，现已接近岐阜。

paragraphs.source_zh: 使者禀报，上游部队已于今晨渡过木曾川，与敌军在米野展开激战，现已接近岐阜。

paragraphs.source_en: “What did you say? He broke his agreement with me and crossed first?”

units.source_en: “What did you say? He broke his agreement with me and crossed first?”

ja.t: だと。あやつはわしとの

units.source_zh: “你说什么，他竟坏了与我的约定，率先渡河了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你说什么，他竟坏了与我的约定，率先渡河了？”

paragraphs.source_en: “No. The enemy provoked us first, and our army had no choice.”

units.source_en: “No. The enemy provoked us first, and our army had no choice.”
units.source_zh: “不，乃是敌人主动挑衅，我军迫不得已。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不，乃是敌人主动挑衅，我军迫不得已。”

paragraphs.source_en: “That damned Sanzaemon! He broke his word and dared make a fool of me!”

units.source_en: “That damned Sanzaemon! He broke his word and dared make a fool of me!”
units.source_zh: “好你个三左卫门，背信弃义，竟敢耍我！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “好你个三左卫门，背信弃义，竟敢耍我！”

paragraphs.source_en: “A duel?”

units.source_en: “A duel?”
units.source_zh: “决斗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “决斗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Fukushima Masanori has been humiliated. Tell him he has not heard the last of this!”

units.source_en: “Fukushima Masanori has been humiliated.
units.source_zh: “福岛正则遭到了羞辱。

units.source_en: Tell him he has not heard the last of this!”
units.source_zh: 告诉他，等着瞧！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “福岛正则遭到了羞辱。告诉他，等着瞧！”

paragraphs.source_en: The messenger froze in terror, then hurriedly withdrew, while Masanori's fury remained unabated. “For the young lord's sake, I volunteered expressly to lead the vanguard, only to have another man steal the honor. How can Masanori ever face the other generals after this? If this causes the Lord of the Inner府 to despise me, I would rather die!”

units.source_en: The messenger froze in terror, then hurriedly withdrew, while Masanori's fury remained unabated.
units.source_zh: 使者吓呆了，慌忙退了下去，正则余怒未消。

units.source_en: “For the young lord's sake, I volunteered expressly to lead the vanguard, only to have another man steal the honor. How can Masanori ever face the other generals after this?
units.source_zh: “为了少君，特意请缨来打前锋，竟被人抢了先，正则日后怎生面对诸将？

units.source_en: If this causes the Lord of the Inner府 to despise me, I would rather die!”

ja.t: んじられるくらいなら、いっそ

units.source_zh: 若因此遭内府轻视，还不如让我去死！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 使者吓呆了，慌忙退了下去，正则余怒未消。“为了少君，特意请缨来打前锋，竟被人抢了先，正则日后怎生面对诸将？若因此遭内府轻视，还不如让我去死！”
